title: Agentic Power BI Squad
summary: A multi-agent system that runs inside VS Code with GitHub Copilot, using 6 domain-specific agents and 15 skills to build complete Power BI (PBIP) projects—including semantic models, DAX measures, and mock CSV datasets—from functional specifications. Its mock-data-generation skill documents SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, HMASynthesizer, and metadata objects as an optional synthetic-data generation pattern that the data-generator agent can invoke on demand, falling back to deterministic generation when SDV is not installed.
